usedFor: RD Station reports conversions and Microsoft Excel keeps the table, so “New Contact Converted” runs “Add Row To Table”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Contact Converted” in RD Station, then “Add Row To Table” in Microsoft Excel
bestTemplate.why: Each form or landing page conversion becomes a row in an Excel table you can filter and share.

watchOut: “Add Row To Table” in Microsoft Excel writes to an Excel table, so the data must sit in a table.
